verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Jira lets users 'use Rovo AI to create custom automations' and have Rovo break down work and auto-assign tasks. That is AI-assisted rule building, adjacent to configuring agent-like behavior, but it is not explicit evidence of building a custom AI agent. Missing for 10: any documented custom agent builder (defining an agent's instructions, knowledge, tools/actions or triggers), configuration docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
